description.value: A mnemonic editor consists of a complex series of virtual reality programs, occult runes, brain implant injectors, and electronic muscle stimulants that can rewrite experiences in dreams and alter muscle memory to learn new skills. Your new memories are remembered as fake, but more vivid than your old memories, which can be vaguely recalled. If you sleep the full 8 hours uninterrupted while wearing a mnemonic editor, when you wake it, count as having spent a month of downtime retraining. The delicate magitech causes it to break down after use; some urban myths claim that the memories it replaces can be salvaged from improperly disposed mnemonic editors.
